IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Agriculture & Rural Economic Development.

Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a matching fund program for agricultural economic planning.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing matching funds for local economicdevelopment strategic planning for agriculture; adding a new section tochapter 15.04 RCW; and creating new sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that economicconditions in the agricultural industry located predominantly in ruralareas of the state have dramatically changed due to a multitude offactors including international market forces, changes in consumerpreferences, available land for agricultural use, and relativecompetitiveness of the region's agricultural economy. Further, inorder to proactively adjust to changing conditions, counties areincreasingly engaging in strategic planning processes to identify thetrends and develop strategies that will better allow their localagricultural communities to identify and capitalize on new and changingopportunities.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 15.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A matching fund program for strategic economic development plans p. 1 SB 5093for agriculture is established, to be administered by the department.The state matching funds shall not exceed fifty percent of the cost ofthe planning process. The state portion for each county shall notexceed forty thousand dollars per county. The legislative authority of a county that wishes to engage in astrategic economic development planning process for agriculture mayfile an application with the department. Applications must besubmitted by September 15th of each year and awarded by October 15th ofeach year. The department and the involved county may contract with WashingtonState University cooperative extension or the University of Washingtonto facilitate discussions with an advisory committee appointed by thecounty in the development of a strategic economic development plan foragriculture for the involved county.
If specific funding for the purposes of thisact, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided byJune 30, 2005, in the omnibus appropriations act, this act is null andvoid.
